liner.note: Unsupported long-tube collapse [R5] 3.5 bar (E 7 GPa ASSUMED), 2.5 bar at 150 C: far below MEOP. The liner relies on (i) the grain web supporting it and (ii) the case gap venting to the chamber at both liner ends (no seals on the liner). A trapped-gap over-pressure at shutdown (chamber tau ~3 ms) is a credible collapse mode near burnout when the web is thin; mitigation: 2 axial vent grooves 1 x 0.3 mm on the liner OD (CAD v3.1 note) and inspection after every firing. Not resolvable by the static FEA.
